items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: But, let me tell you something about Mr. Big Stuff. We went to, on a, I went on a, on a road with her at, we went to New York at the Apollo.

ctx.x: But see, this, I mean, the song is pretty elementary. Yeah. Bump, bump, bump, bump, bump, bump, bump, bump. I mean, that's.

But, let me tell you something, man. Everything that I was affiliated that I, that I arranged and made hits was fundamental. But, let me tell you something about Mr. Big Stuff.
